item.title: Iran war 'has been a strategic disaster for the State of Israel', analyst says
item.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is on a collision course with Donald Trump as the US president seeks to extricate himself from the Iran war, with both men's goals unmet and Israeli military operations tied down in Lebanon. Speaking with FRANCE 24's Sharon Gaffney, Aaron David Miller, senior fellow at the Carnegie Endowment for International Peace, says that "this has been a strategic disaster for the state of Israel. item.title: Interim US-Iran peace deal sparks anger among Israelis, who lash out at Netanyahu
item.description: Israelis from across the political spectrum reacted angrily Monday to the news of an initial deal between the U.S. and Iran, calling it a disaster for Israel and directing their fury at one man: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. FRANCE 24's Noga Tarnopolsky reports from Jerusalem.

item.title: Israel to stay ‘indefinitely’ in lands seized in Gaza, Lebanon and Syria
item.description: Israeli Defence Minister Israel Katz said on Monday that Israeli ground forces would remain in land they hold in Lebanon, Syria and Gaza, potentially challenging a memorandum of understanding announced a day earlier between the US and Iran to end the war in the Middle East.

item.title: המזרח התיכון בשידור חי: פרטי מזכר ארה"ב-איראן יפורסמו בקרוב
item.description: כמה פרטים של מזכר ההבנות שמטרתו לסיים את המלחמה בין ארה"ב לאיראן החלו לצוץ ביום שלישי, כאשר נשיא ארה"ב דונלד טראמפ תיאר זאת כ"עסקה הוגנת". נשיא צרפת עמנואל מקרון אמר בסרטון שפורסם ב-X כי ההסכם הוא "דבר טוב". עקבו אחר הבלוג החי שלנו לכל ההתפתחויות האחרונות.

item.title: Iran says deal to end war with US hinges on Israeli withdrawal from Lebanon
item.description: Iran’s top diplomat said Tuesday that the tentative deal to end the war with the United States would require Israel to withdraw from Lebanon – a condition Israel has already rejected and that could unravel the deal and reignite an all-out war. The US and Iran are expected to formally sign a ceasefire settlement on Friday and open talks about Tehran’s nuclear programme. Read our blog to see how the day's events unfolded.

item.title: US, Iran reach deal to end war
item.description: The United States and Iran agreed a peace deal and an "immediate and permanent" end to military operations on all fronts including Lebanon, mediator Pakistan said, signaling the apparent end to more than three months of war in Middle East. Pakistani Prime Minister Shebhaz Sharif posted on X that a peace deal "has been REACHED" and an official signing ceremony will be held on June 19 in Switzerland. item.title: Netanyahu's Israel grapples with Trump-Iran deal as details remain unclear
item.description: Defense Minister Katz says IDF will remain in Lebanon security zones as Israeli leaders debate Trump-Iran deal's impact on national security interests.

item.title: Israel fears Trump weary of ‘highly suspicious’ Netanyahu and could 'flip' amid Iran deal: analyst
item.description: An analyst says fears are growing in Jerusalem that President Trump could flip on Netanyahu amid U.S.-Iran deal tensions, with strikes in Beirut complicating talks.

item.title: Lebanon reports Israeli strikes in south and east amid broad evacuation warnings
item.description: The Israeli army on Saturday issued evacuation warnings for the southern city of Nabatieh and more than 20 other locations across Lebanon as strikes were reported in the country's south and east. The latest strikes came as the US and Iran indicated they were close to reaching a deal on ending the Middle East war that could also include Lebanon.

item.title: Israelis denounce Trump’s deal with Iran
item.description: Israeli officials disparaged the peace deal and said Israel’s fight against Hezbollah in Lebanon would go on.
